edits.new: If a child requirement fails, test a correction satisfying it while preserving exclusion. If an admitted case remains covered by a parent alternative or permitted connection, attempt a variation preserving the whole child and established exclusions from other routes, and test whether it also escapes that covering route. Do not presume such a variation exists; identify any child requirement or necessary implication preventing it.
